chapter_seo_title: Li Huowang's Public Psychotic Break in Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 229
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang suffers a violent psychotic episode in full view of the Qingqiu village, begging his hallucinated mother for forgiveness.
og_title: A Village Watches a Man Unravel
og_description: Li Huowang’s xinsu condition causes a horrific public breakdown as he argues with ghosts and begs for his mother’s love.
twitter_description: The protagonist’s mental illness takes center stage in a horrifying public spectacle.

lore_anchors.definition: The grassland homeland of Sun Baolu and other former nomads; a relatively peaceful region compared to the horror of Li Huowang’s journey.
A hallucinatory figure Li Huowang argues with, representing a hostile internal voice or an external entity from the Dao-Twisted World.
